title: EvalRun
description: Normalized artifact produced by one benchmark cell: one tool × one repo × one profile × one eval set.

tool.description: Name of the search tool being evaluated.

tool_version.description: Version string for the tool binary. Prefer 'git:<short-sha>' when inside a git repo.

binary.description: Path to the binary that was executed.

repo_id.description: Logical identifier for the repository (from benchmarks/manifests/repos.toml).

repo_path.description: Absolute or project-relative path to the repository root.

repo_sha.description: Git commit SHA at the HEAD of the repo at run time. Null when not resolvable.

profile.description: Path to the benchmark profile TOML that was applied.

eval_set.description: Path to the eval set JSON used for this run.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run began.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the full run in milliseconds.

IndexStats.description: Statistics reported by 'skelesearch status --json' after indexing.

total_chunks.description: Total number of semantic chunks stored.

cache_hits.description: Embedding cache hits during indexing. Null when not reported by the tool.

cache_misses.description: Embedding cache misses during indexing. Null when not reported by the tool.

resolved_import_edges.description: Number of import graph edges resolved. Null when graph indexing is disabled.

AggregateMetrics.description: Aggregate eval metrics across all cases, mirroring 'skelesearch eval --json' aggregate output.

mean_recall_at_5.description: Mean recall at rank 5 across all cases.

mean_recall_at_10.description: Mean recall at rank 10 across all cases.

mean_mrr.description: Mean reciprocal rank across all cases.

total_cases.description: Total number of eval cases evaluated.

CaseResult.description: Per-query result from the eval run.

retrieved_files.description: Ordered list of file paths returned by the search.

Environment.description: Pipeline configuration inferred from the profile TOML and CLI flags.

provider.description: Embedding provider used for indexing and search.

reranker.description: Reranker provider, or null if reranking is disabled.

expansion.description: Whether LLM query expansion was enabled. Null when not specified in profile.

graph.description: Whether import graph traversal was enabled during search.

symbol_enrichment.description: Whether symbol enrichment was applied during indexing.
